info.title: Countersign API
info.summary: Open client files, send the firm's standard agreement for signature, and follow it to a sealed PDF.
info.description: The public API (`/api/v1/*`), the inbound webhook (`/api/inbound/{token}`) and the outbound webhook events. Prose guide: `docs/API.md`. All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. Errors are JSON `{"error": "..."}` with the HTTP status.

servers.description: Placeholder: substitute your deployment's public URL (its APP_URL), e.g. http://localhost:3000 in development.

tags.name: Agreements
tags.description: The workspace's agreements and the custom pre-fill fields they accept.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: A file is one job or case for one client, with one agreement to sign.

tags.name: Inbound webhook
tags.description: No-code entry point for CRMs, n8n and Zapier. Authenticated by the secret URL, not an API key.

get.description: Every agreement that is not archived, oldest first, with its published version (if any) and the custom pre-fill keys that version accepts in `prefill`.
Newest first. Filters are exact matches; an unknown `status` simply matches nothing. `ready_for_work` here is `status == "completed"`; use the single-file read for the full re-check.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Your own reference for the file (CRM id, matter number).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of files to return, clamped to 1-100.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Id of the last file of the previous page; returns the files created before it. The response has `has_more` while more pages remain. 404 if the id isn't a file in this workspace.

post.description: Opens a file for one client on the chosen agreement's published version (or the workspace default) and, unless `send` is `false`, emails the client a signing link. Emits `file.created`, then `file.sent` when the invitation email didn't fail.

201.description: The new file. With `send` on, `status` is `sent`; check `email.status`, since a failed email still returns 201 (the signing link can be copied instead).

404.description: `agreement_id` doesn't name an agreement in this workspace ("Agreement not found").

409.description: No published agreement to use, the chosen agreement has no published version, or another file that is not voided or declined already has this `ref`.

get.summary: Get a file, with a full readiness check
get.description: Re-checks every condition for "ready for work", including that the sealed PDF in storage still matches the SHA-256 recorded when it was sealed. `ready_for_work` here is the result of that check, not just the status.

200.description: The file plus its readiness checks.

get.description: The final, sealed PDF with its audit certificate, sent as an attachment named `<title> - signed.pdf`, where `<title>` is the file's title with characters outside `[A-Za-z0-9 _.-]` removed, runs of spaces collapsed, trimmed and cut to 80 characters (`agreement` if empty). Compare the bytes' SHA-256 with `X-Content-SHA256` (also the `sha256` in the `file.completed` event).

X-Content-SHA256.description: Hex SHA-256 recorded when the PDF was sealed.

Content-Disposition.description: `attachment; filename="<title> - signed.pdf"`, with `<title>` cleaned as described above.

409.description: No sealed PDF yet ("Not completed yet.").

post.description: Sends the reminder email with the same signing link. Only for files in `sent` or `viewed`. Does not change the expiry date and emits no webhook event. No request body.

200.description: The file after the reminder. `email.status` says whether it went out.

409.description: The file isn't `sent` or `viewed` ("Can't remind a <status> file.").

post.description: Cancels the file; the signing link stops working (`signing_url` becomes null). Any status except `completed` and `voided`. Emits `file.voided`.

reason.description: Recorded in the audit trail (first 500 characters). Not returned in the response.

409.description: Already completed or voided, or being countersigned right now (try again shortly).

post.summary: Create a file from a CRM / n8n / Zapier post
post.description: Same behaviour and body as `POST /api/v1/files`, without an API key: the secret token in the URL (Integrations & API page) identifies the workspace. Accepts JSON, `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or `multipart/form-data` (form bodies up to 200 KB; only text fields are read, so `prefill` and `send` can only be sent as JSON). Rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP. Rotating the URL in the app invalidates the old one.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The workspace's inbound token. Treat the whole URL as a secret.

404.description: Unknown inbound URL, or `agreement_id` not found.

409.description: No published agreement to use, or the `ref` is already in use.

post.description: The file is countersigned and sealed. `data` also carries `sha256`, the SHA-256 of the sealed PDF.

2XX.description: Received. Any other status (including a 3xx: redirects are not followed), a network error or a timeout is retried. Each attempt allows 10 s to connect, 10 s for the response headers and 10 s between body chunks, within 12 s overall; the response body is not used.

apiKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer cs_live_...`. Keys are created (and shown once) on Integrations & API; admins only. A revoked key returns 401. Limit: 120 requests per minute per client IP.

HookEvent.name: X-Countersign-Event
HookEvent.description: The event name, same as `event` in the body.

HookDelivery.name: X-Countersign-Delivery
HookDelivery.description: The delivery id (`wd_...`), same as `id` in the body and the same on every retry. Use it to de-duplicate.

HookSignature.name: X-Countersign-Signature
HookSignature.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the webhook's signing secret>`. `t` is set per attempt.

post.description: Sent to every active webhook subscribed to this event (or to all events). `data` is the file, as returned by the API at the moment of the event, except for `file.sent`: there `data` is read before the invitation's email status is recorded, so `data.email.status` and `data.email.error` show their previous values (null for a first invitation). `file.sent` fires only for a file's first invitation: sending a declined or expired file again from the app returns it to `sent` without emitting any event, and resends and reminders emit nothing.

2XX.description: Received. Any other status (including a 3xx: redirects are not followed), a network error or a timeout is retried. Each attempt allows 10 s to connect, 10 s for the response headers and 10 s between body chunks, within 12 s overall; the response body is not used.

BadRequest.description: The body isn't valid JSON ("Body must be JSON."), or a form upload couldn't be read.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked API key.

EmailNotConfirmed.description: The workspace owner hasn't confirmed their email yet (when the deployment requires it), so agreements can only go to the firm's own team.

FileNotFound.description: No file with this id in the key's workspace ("File not found").

TooLarge.description: Request body over the limit (2 MB for JSON).

ValidationError.description: The body failed validation. `error` lists each problem as `<field>: <message>`, separated by `; `, e.g. `client_name: required; client_email: must be a valid email`.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit reached. Wait a minute and retry.

TooManyRequestsOrDailyCap.description: Rate limit reached, or the workspace has opened its daily cap of files in the last 24 hours (300 unless the deployment sets otherwise).

ServerError.description: Unexpected error ("Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.").

FileStatus.description: `draft` created, not sent; `sent` link emailed; `viewed` client opened it; `signed` client signed, awaiting countersignature; `completed` countersigned and sealed; `declined` client declined; `voided` cancelled by the firm; `expired` link passed its expiry date unsigned.

id.description: Pass as `agreement_id` when creating a file.

default.description: Used when a file names no agreement.

published_version.description: The active published version number; null if never published.

prefill_fields.description: Custom pre-fill fields on the published version. Send values as `prefill: {"<key>": "..."}`.

NewFile.description: Accepts our field names and common CRM names, so a raw record can be posted. Where two names are given for one value, the first listed wins. Strings are trimmed. Unknown properties are ignored.

agreement_id.description: Agreement to use. Omit for the default (or newest) published agreement.

ref.description: Your reference (CRM id, matter number). Numbers are converted to strings. Must be unique among files that are not voided or declined.

prefill.description: Values for the agreement's custom pre-fill fields, keyed by `key` from `prefill_fields` (a `custom.` prefix is also accepted and stripped). Keys up to 60 characters; values are stored as strings. For checkbox fields, `1`, `true`, `yes` or `x` ticks the box.

send.description: `false` creates a draft without emailing the client.

NewFileForm.description: Form-encoded variant of `NewFile`: text fields only. Sending `send` or `prefill` as a form field fails validation (422); use JSON for those.

sent_at.description: When the file was last sent from `draft`, `expired` or `declined` (its first invitation, or sending a closed file again). Not changed by reminders or by resending a file that is still open.

completed_at.description: When the firm countersigned and the PDF was sealed.

expires_at.description: When the signing link expires if unsigned. Set when sent, and pushed back by a resend from the app (not by reminders).

ready_for_work.description: In lists, events and write responses: `status == "completed"`. In `GET /api/v1/files/{id}`: the full readiness check.

status.description: Last invitation/reminder email: `sent` delivered to the mail server, `failed` (see `error`), `logged` recorded in the app's email log without going to a mail server (e.g. none configured), null never sent.

copy_emailed_at.description: When the client was emailed their signed copy.

signing_url.description: The client's private signing link (`<app>/s/<token>`). Null once voided. Treat as a secret: whoever has it can sign.

document_url.description: `<app>/api/v1/files/<id>/document` once completed, else null. Needs the API key.

app_url.description: The file in the app, for staff.

required.description: Only required checks decide `ready_for_work`; `copy_emailed` is informational.

id.description: Delivery id (`wd_...`), same as `X-Countersign-Delivery`. One per webhook per event.

created_at.description: When the event happened (not when this attempt was sent).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sealed PDF; matches `X-Content-SHA256` on the download.
